column4: Fresh bypass host 23: enrolled and MDM On during setup with no prompt; lab1 desktop reached with no prompt. Ready for W-1.

No-bypass build: Fleet blocks enrollment until the IdP sign-in, which happens in Edge on the setup screen (26H2 has a browser there). Host 22 enrolled 28 s after sign-in with the IdP user linked and MDM On, before any user account.

Both packages kept as C:\ProgramData\Microsoft\Provisioning\<name>.ppkg, the folder Microsoft names for doWipePersistProvisionedData. C:\Recovery stays empty. Users and Everyone can read the file, so any signed-in user can extract the MSI and its enroll secret (unencrypted packages; encrypted not tested, see E-1).
